OnlinePortalInfomartion:
The Virgin Islands Department of Immigration Online Clearance Portal allows captains of private transports to submit information about their transports and travelers entering and departing the Virgin Islands.

Manifests submitted through the Online Clearance Portal are reviewed by Immigration staff.

Captains can expect to receive a confirmation email once the manifest is submitted. After the review process, another email is sent with the clearance status of each traveler. Captains can edit a submitted manifest up until Immigration begins to process it. To edit a manifest, have the Manifest ID from your confirmation email handy.

All arrivals must be registered a minimum of one hour prior to arriving in the British Virgin Islands.

BVI Department of Immigration does not sell, transfer, or disclose any information gathered at our websites to anyone outside the Government of The Virgin Islands.
